name: Akiflow
tagline: One app for tasks and calendars, powered by AI.
description: Akiflow is a keyboard-first daily planner that pulls tasks from email, Slack, Notion, and dozens of other tools into a single inbox, then lets you time-block them onto a unified calendar. Its built-in assistant, Aki, handles AI scheduling, prioritization, daily briefings, and natural-language and voice commands. It runs on macOS, Windows, web, iOS, and Android with real-time sync.
insight: Backed by Y Combinator; the keyboard-first command bar predates the 'Aki' AI assistant, which was layered on later.

modelSupport.notes: Aki assistant for AI scheduling, prioritization, and voice/natural-language commands.

edge: Keyboard-first command bar that unifies tasks from email, Slack, and Notion into one time-blocked calendar, with the Aki assistant auto-planning your day.
pros: Unifies tasks from many tools in one inbox
Native desktop, web, and mobile apps
cons: AI is a newer layer on a planner
Can be overkill for light task lists
